security.summary: This pack contains only vehicle assets, metadata, and a benign data-only fxmanifest. No executable behavior, downloads, webhooks, obfuscation, or hidden payloads were found.

findings.reason: Manifest is declarative only and lists recognized vehicle metadata files; no runtime scripts or web UI assets are loaded.

repairs.issue: The manifest is safe but the importer does not rely on uploaded manifests.
repairs.action: Rebuild the manifest from the actual copied vehicle assets and metadata.

request.instructions: no drift, perfect steering at all speeds, insanely high acceleration, incredibly high braking

changes.reason: Acceleration much higher (30%)
Braking much higher (30%)
Grip much higher (30%)

request.instructions: make it turn flawlessly at high speeds even when accelerating and my foots on the gas, making braking super fast, ALMOST instantaneous, NO DRIFTING, ONLY PERFECT TURNS

changes.reason: Slightly reduced steering angle to improve high-speed cornering stability and reduce drifting.
Increased braking strength for much faster stopping.
Moved brake balance slightly forward to keep hard braking stable.
Raised peak grip for better turn-in and cornering under power.
Raised sustained grip to reduce slide and keep turns clean at speed.
Reduced traction loss to minimize drifting and wheelspin in turns.
Reduced low-speed wheelspin while accelerating out of corners.
Added a small front bias to help the car hold a straighter line through fast turns.
Increased roll resistance to keep the chassis flatter and more precise in corners.
Balanced anti-roll toward the front for steadier high-speed turn-in.
Added a bit more drive force to support the higher-grip setup without hurting drivability.

request.instructions: never flips over no matter what

changes.reason: Lowering the center of mass helps the car stay planted and resist flipping.
Lower roll center reduces body roll and rollover tendency.
Lower roll center helps keep the rear planted in fast direction changes.
A slightly stiffer anti-roll bar improves stability in corners without making it undriveable.

request.instructions: make it so it never flips or rolls over (it does right now), and make acceleration a lot higher and faster

changes.reason: Raises acceleration substantially to match the requested faster launch and pull.
Lowering the center of mass helps the car resist flipping and rolling over.
More roll/yaw inertia improves stability and makes the car less prone to tipping.
Stiffer anti-roll behavior reduces body roll and rollover tendency.
Higher roll center helps keep the chassis flatter in cornering.
Higher rear roll center supports rollover resistance.
Slightly firmer suspension supports stability at very high speed.
Adds damping to reduce abrupt weight transfer that can cause flips.
Helps control chassis rebound and keeps the car settled over bumps.
Gives the tires a bit more grip to support the higher acceleration and speed.

request.instructions: right now once it hits 100 the acceleration is super slow, make the acceleration super fast until it hits 300mph

changes.reason: Stronger acceleration so the car keeps pulling hard at higher speeds.
Improves throttle response and helps the car continue accelerating more aggressively at speed.
Faster shift execution to maintain acceleration through the gears.
Keeps shift behavior balanced after increasing upshift rate.
Adds one more gear to better support acceleration all the way to a much higher top speed.
Raises the top-speed ceiling so the vehicle can continue accelerating toward the requested 300 mph target.
Extra braking support for the higher performance tune.

request.instructions: make it so it turns instantly no matter how fast im going

changes.reason: Increase steering angle so the car can turn more sharply at higher speeds.
Add lateral grip support so the higher steering angle remains controllable.
Reduce slide tendency to help the car hold the tighter turning input.
Slightly firm up the chassis to keep response crisp during rapid direction changes.
